thread:
Alex: Morning team — quick runtime standup. Kernel patch merged to feature/kernel-ops yesterday. Local unit + integration ran green but need a second review before landing to main.

Priya: What I did: reviewed Alex's kernel change, left a couple of nits around allocator alignment. Also ran batching microbench: throughput +12% at batch=8 on T4.
Blockers: CI flake in perf-matrix job causing false negatives.
Today: I'll push a cleanup PR to address allocator comments and re-run matrix.

Jun: What I did: tracked down KV cache eviction bug — found an off-by-one when a slot wraps. Minimal repro:
```
kv.size = 64
for i in range(65): insert(key+i)
# last key overwrote neighbor, idx calc uses (pos-1) mod size
```
Blocker: need to reproduce reliably on quantized models.
Today: adding additional asserts and a small fuzz harness.

Sam: What I did: ran full perf suite on the patched runtime. Initial numbers look good but tail latency spikes when batch>32.
Blocker: not sure if it's batching logic or kernel preemption.
Today: I'll run `TRACE=1 ./run_bench --batch=32` and capture traces.

Casey: Taking Alex's kernel PR for final signoff this morning. Also planning a small canary with 10% traffic to benchmark infra.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: infra/canary-20260306 -> 10% traffic at 10:30 UTC. Watch perf-dash.

Alex: FYI @Priya @Jun — if CI flakes persist, we can mark the matrix as optional and merge the kernel fixes; prefer to not block rollout. I'll follow up with a brief changelog.

Priya: +1 on optional for matrix if we have green integration tests. Will file the follow-up.

Jun: I'll post the fuzz harness results in this thread once I have a repro case.

Sam: ping @Casey — if you see tail spikes in canary, we should auto-fallback to previous kernel variant.

Alex: Thanks everyone. Quick ask: if anyone runs the perf commands, paste the top 3 numbers (p50/p95/p99) here so we can compare.
